shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.intro: ru.Cloud ships to all 58 wilayas in Algeria. Every order is prepared with care in our atelier and handed to a trusted carrier for home delivery or stop-desk pickup.
shipping.p1: Home delivery (à domicile) brings your parcel directly to the address you entered at checkout. Stop desk delivery lets you collect your order from the carrier's agency in your wilaya; it is usually cheaper, but only available where the carrier offers it. If stop desk is not available for your wilaya, the option is disabled at checkout.
shipping.p2: Delivery fees depend on the wilaya and the delivery type you choose. The exact amount is shown in your bag and in the order summary before you confirm — there are no hidden charges.
shipping.p3: We dispatch ready-to-wear orders within 3 business days (Sunday to Thursday, excluding public holidays). Made-to-order pieces may take longer; the estimated timeframe is shown on the product page or shared with you by email. Once dispatched, you receive a confirmation with your tracking details.
shipping.p4: You can review your orders and their status in your account. For an address change, a delayed parcel, or delivery in a remote wilaya, email ruclouddz@gmail.com with your order number.
shipping.p5: Cash on delivery is available across Algeria. For BaridiMob, CCP and bank transfers, upload your payment receipt from your order so we can confirm it before dispatch.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.intro: We want you to love what you wear. If a piece is not right, you have 14 days after receiving it to request a return or an exchange.
returns.p1: Items must be unworn, unwashed, unaltered, and returned with their original tags and packaging. Hygiene items and made-to-measure pieces are excluded. Keep your delivery note or order number: we need it to process your request.
returns.p2: Email ruclouddz@gmail.com with your order number, the item you want to return, and the reason. We will reply with the address to send the parcel back to and the next steps. Please do not send anything before receiving our instructions, as return costs and shipping method depend on your wilaya.
returns.p3: Once the parcel is received and checked, we confirm by email. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 days of confirmation. For cash on delivery orders, we arrange a bank transfer or CCP refund using the details you provide.
returns.p4: For a different size or colour, tell us your preferred option in the same email. Exchanges are subject to stock availability. We cover the return shipping cost when the exchange is due to an error on our side or a faulty item.
returns.p5: If an item arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, contact us within 48 hours with photos of the parcel and the item. We will arrange a replacement or a full refund at no cost to you.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Quick answers about delivery, payment, returns, and your account. If your question is not here, write to ruclouddz@gmail.com.
faq.a1: For now we deliver to all 58 Algerian wilayas only. International shipping is not available yet; email us if you are abroad and would like to be notified.
faq.a2: Orders are dispatched within 3 business days. Delivery time then depends on your wilaya and whether you chose home delivery or stop desk.
faq.q3: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: Cash on delivery, BaridiMob, CCP transfer, and bank transfer. International card payments are not yet active.
faq.q4: Can I change my delivery address or order?
faq.a4: Email us as soon as possible with your order number. We can update details before dispatch; once handed to the carrier, changes are no longer possible.
faq.q5: How do returns and exchanges work?
faq.a5: You have 14 days after receipt. Email ruclouddz@gmail.com with your order number and we will send you the return or exchange instructions. See our Returns page for details.
faq.q6: How is my personal data handled?
faq.a6: We only store the information needed to process your order and improve your experience. See our Privacy page for the full details, or contact ruclouddz@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of Sale
terms.intro: These terms govern purchases made on the ru.Cloud website. By placing an order, you agree to the terms below.
terms.p1: All prices are shown in Algerian dinars (DZD) and include VAT where applicable. Shipping fees are calculated at checkout and displayed before payment. Prices may change, but the price confirmed in your order applies to that order.
terms.p2: An order is confirmed only after you submit the checkout form and receive our confirmation email. We may decline or cancel an order if an item is out of stock, if payment cannot be verified, or if the delivery details are incomplete. You will be notified by email and refunded if payment was already made.
terms.p3: Stock is limited, especially for small-batch pieces. An item in your bag is not reserved until the order is confirmed. If a product becomes unavailable after your order, we will contact you to agree on an exchange, a waiting period, or a refund.
terms.p4: We accept cash on delivery, BaridiMob, CCP transfer, and bank transfer within Algeria. For non-cash methods, payment must be made within 48 hours of placing the order and the receipt uploaded to your order; unconfirmed payments may lead to cancellation.
terms.p5: Product names, photographs, and brand content belong to ru.Cloud and may not be reused without written permission.
terms.p6: Questions about these terms? Email ruclouddz@gmail.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ru.Cloud respects your privacy. This page explains what we collect, why we collect it, and what choices you have.
privacy.p1: When you create an account or place an order, we store your name, email address, phone number, delivery address, city and wilaya, and the contents of your order. If you pay by CCP, BaridiMob, or bank transfer, we store the payment reference and the receipt image you upload so we can verify the payment.
privacy.p2: We use this information to process and deliver your order, answer your questions, prevent fraud, and, with your consent, send occasional updates about new collections. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.p3: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in, remember your bag, and protect forms from cross-site request forgery. We may use aggregated, anonymised analytics to understand which pages are visited; this does not identify you personally.
privacy.p4: Order records are kept as long as needed to manage your purchases and meet legal obligations. Access is limited to the people who need it to fulfil orders, and data is stored on secured servers.
privacy.p5: You can ask to see, correct, or delete your personal data, or unsubscribe from our emails, at any time by writing to ruclouddz@gmail.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

info.more_questions: Still have a question? Email us at ruclouddz@gmail.com — we usually reply within 24 hours.

story.title:
Born from the shadows,
dressed in light.
story.brand_p1: rucloud was created from the idea that clothing should feel more than beautiful, it should feel meaningful.
story.brand_p2: Built around calm silhouettes, soft strength, and timeless elegance, rucloud designs are made for women who carry presence and power quietly.
story.brand_p3: Inspired by emotion, resilience, and the beauty of simplicity, each piece is created to blend comfort, femininity, and confidence into everyday life.
story.brand_closing:
rucloud is not driven by trends.
It is driven by identity.
story.founder_p1: rucloud was founded by Rokia, a young creative balancing fashion, technology, and entrepreneurship.
story.founder_p2: What began as a personal creative escape slowly became a vision: building a brand that combines emotion, minimalism, and strong feminine energy.
story.founder_p3: From managing ateliers to designing collections while studying and working in tech, rucloud reflects a journey built with persistence, curiosity, and passion for meaningful creation.
story.founder_p4: Every collection is approached with intention, focusing on timeless pieces, refined details, and emotional connection.
story.founder_p5: Algerian Designer Rokia harnesses her self-taught skills, obtained in her great aunt's sewing atelier in Algeria, to create contemporary modest fashion designs. With her signature style and impactful digital presence, Rokia BOUFRAH built an empire over the years. Wanting to share her true passion with the women of the world, Rokia founded her namesake brand rucloud in 2023.
story.founder_p6: Rokia has turned her greatest passion into a global leading modest fashion brand, with a community of women that are as fashionable as they are inspiring and resilient.
story.founder_p7: For Rokia, fashion has always played an important part in her life and identity and expresses her creativity through her personal style. After making the personal decision to cover her hair, she struggled to find clothing that aligned as much with her personal style as it did with her core beliefs and values. This inspired her to create clothing that she could personally identify with, hoping that women with similar experiences would feel seen and heard.
story.founder_p8: With this innovative and contemporary approach, Rokia has become one of the pioneers of modest fashion and hopes to be a deciding voice in the fashion industry, and with unity and inclusivity in mind, to change it for the better.
